name: pr_overview

comment: Current PR state overview, all states and authors.

name: pr_merge_summary
semantic_sql: SELECT merged_prs, mean_merge_hours, median_merge_hours, p90_merge_hours FROM crossfield_pipeline('github','{"version":1,"source_bindings":{"pulls":{"arguments":{"repo":{"member":"repository_input.repo"},"state":{"literal":"all"},"base":{"literal":""},"max_rows":{"literal":"0"},"cache_ttl":{"literal":"0"}},"driver":{"input":"selection"},"allow_driving_grain_reduction":true}},"inputs":{"selection":{"definition":"repository_input","rows":[[{"parameter":"repository"}]]}}}',$repository) WHERE pulls.merged_day >= $start_day AND pulls.merged_day < $end_day
comment: Merged-in-period throughput and elapsed creation-to-merge hours. Half-open UTC merge-date cohort.

name: pr_merges_daily
semantic_sql: SELECT pulls.merged_day AS merge_day, merged_prs, mean_merge_hours, median_merge_hours, p90_merge_hours FROM crossfield_pipeline('github','{"version":1,"source_bindings":{"pulls":{"arguments":{"repo":{"member":"repository_input.repo"},"state":{"literal":"all"},"base":{"literal":""},"max_rows":{"literal":"0"},"cache_ttl":{"literal":"0"}},"driver":{"input":"selection"},"allow_driving_grain_reduction":true}},"inputs":{"selection":{"definition":"repository_input","rows":[[{"parameter":"repository"}]]}}}',$repository) WHERE pulls.merged_day >= $start_day AND pulls.merged_day < $end_day GROUP BY pulls.merged_day ORDER BY pulls.merged_day
comment: Daily merged cohort; missing days stay missing, never filled with zero.

name: pr_merges_by_author
semantic_sql: SELECT pulls.user_login AS author, merged_prs, mean_merge_hours, median_merge_hours, p90_merge_hours FROM crossfield_pipeline('github','{"version":1,"source_bindings":{"pulls":{"arguments":{"repo":{"member":"repository_input.repo"},"state":{"literal":"all"},"base":{"literal":""},"max_rows":{"literal":"0"},"cache_ttl":{"literal":"0"}},"driver":{"input":"selection"},"allow_driving_grain_reduction":true}},"inputs":{"selection":{"definition":"repository_input","rows":[[{"parameter":"repository"}]]}}}',$repository) WHERE pulls.merged_day >= $start_day AND pulls.merged_day < $end_day GROUP BY pulls.user_login ORDER BY pulls.user_login NULLS LAST
comment: Merged-in-period cohort by author; bots included. Means/percentiles cannot be averaged across authors.

name: merged_pr_detail
semantic_sql: SELECT pulls.id AS id, pulls.repo AS repository, pulls.number AS number, pulls.title AS title, pulls.user_login AS author, pulls.created_at AS created_at, pulls.merged_at AS merged_at, pulls.merge_hours AS merge_hours, pulls.labels AS labels, pulls.html_url AS url FROM crossfield_pipeline('github','{"version":1,"source_bindings":{"pulls":{"arguments":{"repo":{"member":"repository_input.repo"},"state":{"literal":"all"},"base":{"literal":""},"max_rows":{"literal":"0"},"cache_ttl":{"literal":"0"}},"driver":{"input":"selection"},"allow_driving_grain_reduction":true}},"inputs":{"selection":{"definition":"repository_input","rows":[[{"parameter":"repository"}]]}},"detail_dataset":"pulls"}',$repository) WHERE pulls.merged_day >= $start_day AND pulls.merged_day < $end_day ORDER BY pulls.id
comment: The same merged cohort as pr_merge_summary, one row per PR.
